title: 科學：量度液體體積
Science: measuring liquid volume
question: 水在量筒內形成凹液面。要減少視差，應如何讀數？
Water forms a concave meniscus in a measuring cylinder. How should you read its volume to reduce parallax error?
options: 視線與凹液面最低點同高，量筒放在水平桌面。
Read the bottom of the meniscus at eye level, with the cylinder on a level bench.
眼睛與刻度同高可減少視差；水應讀凹液面最低點。
An eye-level reading reduces parallax; read the bottom of water's meniscus.
手持量筒傾斜，從上方讀最高點。
Tilt the cylinder and read the highest point from above.
傾斜和斜視都會使讀數偏離正確體積。
Tilting and viewing from above distort the reading.
只讀最接近的整十刻度，不理會小刻度。
Use the nearest multiple of ten and ignore smaller divisions.
忽略可讀的小刻度會降低量度精確度。
Ignoring readable subdivisions reduces measurement precision.
takeaway: 量度須配合儀器刻度、正確視線與一致程序。
Use the instrument's scale, correct viewing position and a consistent procedure.

title: 科學：分離混合物
Science: separating a mixture
question: 混合物含沙和食鹽。要分別取得乾沙與食鹽，哪個次序合理？所有加熱均由老師監督。
A mixture contains sand and salt. Which sequence can recover dry sand and salt separately? All heating is teacher-supervised.
options: 加水攪拌 → 過濾 → 乾燥沙；把濾液蒸發結晶。
Add water and stir → filter → dry the sand; evaporate the filtrate to obtain salt.
鹽溶於水而沙不溶，過濾先分出沙，蒸發再取得鹽。
Salt dissolves but sand does not; filtration separates sand and evaporation recovers salt.
直接過濾乾混合物，再用磁鐵分鹽。
Filter the dry mixture, then remove salt with a magnet.
沒有溶劑時過濾不能按溶解性分離；食鹽也不具磁性。
Dry filtration does not separate by solubility, and salt is not magnetic.
加水後只取濾紙上的物質，便得到兩者。
Add water and keep only the filter residue to recover both.
食鹽會留在濾液中，丟棄濾液便失去食鹽。
Salt remains dissolved in the filtrate, so discarding it loses the salt.
takeaway: 分離方法利用物質性質的差異，並要追蹤每種物質去了哪裏。
Separation uses differences in properties; track where each substance goes.

title: 科學：辨認混雜變項
Science: identifying confounding variables
question: 甲把細糖放入 60°C 水，乙把糖粒放入 20°C 水；甲溶解較快。他們想研究溫度的影響。應怎樣改良？
A uses fine sugar in water at 60°C; B uses large sugar crystals at 20°C. A dissolves faster. They want to study temperature. How should they improve the comparison?
options: 使用相同大小及質量的糖、水量和攪拌方法，只改變溫度。
Keep sugar size and mass, water volume and stirring the same; change only temperature.
糖粒大小也影響溶解速率，必須控制才能隔離溫度的影響。
Particle size also affects dissolution rate, so it must be controlled to isolate temperature.
把甲的水量加倍，其他不變。
Double A's water volume and keep everything else unchanged.
這增加另一個變項，並未控制糖粒大小。
This adds another variable without controlling particle size.
只做一次更快的計時便可證明溫度是唯一原因。
Time one trial more precisely to prove temperature is the only cause.
計時精確不能消除實驗設計中的混雜因素。
Precise timing does not remove a confounding variable in the design.
takeaway: 公平測試須控制可能影響結果的其他變項。
A fair test controls other variables that may affect the outcome.

title: 科學：細胞結構與功能
Science: cell structures and functions
question: 顯微鏡下的洋蔥表皮細胞有明顯外框。哪個配對最準確？
Onion epidermal cells show a clear outer boundary under a microscope. Which structure–function pairing is most accurate?
options: 細胞壁提供支持；細胞膜控制物質進出。
The cell wall provides support; the cell membrane regulates movement of substances.
細胞壁與細胞膜是不同結構，功能不能互換。
The wall and membrane are different structures with different functions.
細胞核提供所有外部支持，細胞壁儲存全部遺傳物質。
The nucleus provides all external support; the wall stores all genetic material.
細胞核含主要遺傳物質；細胞壁主要提供支持。
The nucleus contains the main genetic material; the wall mainly provides support.
所有植物細胞都必須含大量葉綠體。
Every plant cell must contain many chloroplasts.
例如洋蔥鱗莖表皮通常沒有葉綠體，不能概括所有植物細胞。
Onion bulb epidermal cells typically lack chloroplasts; not all plant cells have them.
takeaway: 根據結構和功能解釋細胞，避免把典型圖像當成所有細胞的樣子。
Explain cells through structure and function, without treating a typical diagram as universal.

title: 科學：串聯電路的電壓
Science: voltage in a series circuit
question: 在理想電路中，2 Ω 和 4 Ω 電阻串聯接上 12 V 電源。已知 V = IR。4 Ω 電阻兩端電壓是多少？
In an ideal circuit, 2 Ω and 4 Ω resistors are connected in series to a 12 V source. Use V = IR. What is the voltage across the 4 Ω resistor?
options: 8 V
8 V
總電阻 6 Ω，電流 12÷6=2 A；4 Ω 上的電壓為 2×4=8 V。
Total resistance is 6 Ω, so current is 2 A; the voltage across 4 Ω is 2×4=8 V.
12 V 是兩個串聯電阻的總電壓，不是各自的電壓。
12 V is the total across both series resistors, not across each one.
6 V
6 V
電阻不相等，電壓並非平均分配。
The resistances differ, so the voltage is not shared equally.
takeaway: 串聯電路電流相同，電壓按電阻大小分配。
Series components carry the same current; voltage divides in proportion to resistance.

title: 科學：從氣體變化推論
Science: interpreting gas changes
question: 兩組相同水草分別放在光亮和黑暗中，其他條件相同。光亮組氧氣增加，黑暗組氧氣減少。哪個解釋最合理？
Identical aquatic plants are kept in light or darkness under otherwise equal conditions. Oxygen rises in the light group and falls in the dark group. Which explanation best fits?
options: 光亮組光合作用產氧多於呼吸耗氧；黑暗組仍呼吸。
In light, photosynthesis produces more oxygen than respiration uses; in darkness, respiration continues.
觀察到的是產氧和耗氧兩個過程的淨結果。
The observation is the net result of oxygen production and use.
植物只在黑暗時呼吸，光亮時完全停止。
Plants respire only in darkness and stop completely in light.
植物在光亮時也進行呼吸，不能把氧氣增加理解為沒有呼吸。
Plants also respire in light; rising oxygen does not mean respiration has stopped.
光亮組的氧氣增加代表水草只呼吸而沒有光合作用。
The oxygen increase means the illuminated plants respire without photosynthesising.
呼吸消耗氧氣，不能單獨解釋氧氣淨增加。
Respiration consumes oxygen and cannot alone explain a net increase.
takeaway: 同時存在的過程可能互相抵銷；量度常顯示淨變化。
Simultaneous processes can offset each other; measurements often show a net change.

title: 科學：原子與離子
Science: atoms and ions
question: 一粒子有 12 個質子、12 個中子及 10 個電子。其質量數和電荷分別是甚麼？
A particle has 12 protons, 12 neutrons and 10 electrons. What are its mass number and charge?
options: 質量數 24，電荷 2+。
Mass number 24; charge 2+.
質量數為質子加中子；正電荷比負電荷多 2。
Mass number is protons plus neutrons; there are two more positive than negative charges.
質量數 22，電荷 2−。
Mass number 22; charge 2−.
電子不計入質量數；電子較少應帶正電。
Electrons are not counted in the mass number; fewer electrons gives a positive charge.
質量數 12，沒有電荷。
Mass number 12; no charge.
12 是質子數；質子和電子數不同，所以不是中性。
12 is the proton number; unequal proton and electron counts mean it is not neutral.
takeaway: 分清質子數、質量數和淨電荷，使用各自定義計算。
Distinguish proton number, mass number and net charge using their definitions.

title: 科學：中和與能量轉移
Science: neutralisation and energy transfer
question: 在老師示範中，酸與鹼混合後溫度由 22°C 升至 28°C。忽略外界熱量交換，哪項解釋合理？
In a teacher demonstration, mixing an acid and an alkali raises the temperature from 22°C to 28°C. Ignoring heat exchange with the surroundings, which interpretation is reasonable?
options: 反應釋放能量到溶液，屬放熱反應。
The reaction transfers energy to the solution and is exothermic.
溶液升溫顯示反應釋出的能量增加了溶液的熱能。
The temperature rise indicates energy released by the reaction increases the solution's thermal energy.
反應吸收溶液熱能，所以溶液升溫。
The reaction absorbs thermal energy from the solution, making it warmer.
若反應從溶液吸熱而無其他來源，溶液會降溫。
Absorbing energy from the solution would cool it without another energy source.
所有酸鹼混合後必定變成 pH 7。
Every acid–alkali mixture must end at pH 7.
最終 pH 還取決於酸鹼種類及用量；升溫不能證明完全中和。
Final pH depends on substances and amounts; warming alone does not prove complete neutralisation.
takeaway: 溫度變化提供能量轉移證據，但不能代替其他化學量度。
Temperature change provides evidence of energy transfer, not every other chemical property.

title: 科學：空氣阻力的證據
Science: evidence about air resistance
question: 同一張紙先攤平、再揉成球，從相同高度分別放手。紙球較快到地面。哪項結論最符合這個設計？
The same sheet is dropped flat and then crumpled into a ball from the same height. The ball reaches the ground sooner. Which conclusion best matches the design?
options: 質量相同而形狀不同，結果支持形狀影響空氣阻力。
Mass is unchanged while shape differs; the result supports an effect of shape on air resistance.
同一張紙保持質量，形狀改變迎風面及空氣阻力。
Using the same sheet keeps mass fixed while shape changes the area presented to the air.
紙球的重力必定是原來的兩倍。
The ball's gravitational force must be twice as large.
紙的質量沒有變，不能由落地較快推斷重力加倍。
The mass has not changed; faster falling does not imply twice the gravitational force.
真空中也一定有相同時間差。
The same time difference must occur in a vacuum.
此實驗在空氣中進行，不能把空氣阻力的結果直接套用到真空。
This air-based result cannot be transferred unchanged to a vacuum.
takeaway: 辨認實驗保持了甚麼、改變了甚麼，再界定結論範圍。
Identify what was held constant and changed before setting a conclusion's scope.

title: 化學：離子晶體的導電性
Chemistry: conduction in ionic substances
question: 固態氯化鈉不導電，熔融氯化鈉導電。最合理的微觀解釋是甚麼？
Solid sodium chloride does not conduct electricity, but molten sodium chloride does. Which microscopic explanation is best?
options: 熔融時離子可自由移動並傳遞電荷。
Ions can move through the melt and carry charge.
固體內離子位置固定；熔融後可移動，毋須假設產生自由電子。
Ions are fixed in the solid lattice but mobile in the melt; free electrons are not the charge carriers.
固體完全沒有帶電粒子，熔融才產生離子。
The solid has no charged particles; melting creates ions.
固體本來已由離子組成，差別是離子的流動性。
The solid already contains ions; their mobility changes.
熔融令氯化鈉變成金屬，靠自由電子導電。
Melting turns sodium chloride into a metal conducting by free electrons.
物態改變不會令離子化合物變成金屬。
A change of state does not turn an ionic compound into a metal.
takeaway: 解釋導電性時須指出可移動的帶電粒子。
Explain conductivity by identifying mobile charge carriers.

title: 化學：物質的量與氣體體積
Chemistry: amount and gas volume
question: CaCO₃ + 2HCl → CaCl₂ + H₂O + CO₂。10.0 g 純 CaCO₃ 與過量酸完全反應。CaCO₃ 摩爾質量 100 g mol⁻¹；該條件下氣體摩爾體積 24.0 dm³ mol⁻¹。CO₂ 體積？
CaCO₃ + 2HCl → CaCl₂ + H₂O + CO₂. 10.0 g of pure CaCO₃ reacts completely with excess acid. Its molar mass is 100 g mol⁻¹; gas molar volume is 24.0 dm³ mol⁻¹. What volume of CO₂ forms?
options: 2.40 dm³
2.40 dm³
CaCO₃ 為 0.100 mol；CO₂ 比例 1:1，體積 0.100×24.0=2.40 dm³。
CaCO₃ is 0.100 mol; the CO₂ ratio is 1:1, giving 0.100×24.0=2.40 dm³.
4.80 dm³
4.80 dm³
係數 2 屬 HCl，並非 CO₂；不能把 CO₂ 物質的量加倍。
The coefficient 2 belongs to HCl, not CO₂; it does not double the CO₂ amount.
240 dm³
240 dm³
須先把克數除以摩爾質量，不能直接乘摩爾體積。
Convert grams to moles before multiplying by molar volume.
takeaway: 依次轉換質量、物質的量比及體積，保留單位。
Convert mass to amount, apply the mole ratio, then convert to volume with units.

title: 化學：限制反應物
Chemistry: limiting reagent
question: Mg + 2HCl → MgCl₂ + H₂。0.120 mol Mg 與 0.200 mol HCl 反應至完成。哪項正確？
Mg + 2HCl → MgCl₂ + H₂. 0.120 mol Mg reacts with 0.200 mol HCl to completion. Which statement is correct?
options: H₂ 為 0.100 mol，餘下 Mg 0.020 mol。
0.100 mol H₂ forms and 0.020 mol Mg remains.
HCl 只足以消耗 0.100 mol Mg，所以酸是限制反應物。
The HCl can consume only 0.100 mol Mg, so acid is limiting.
H₂ 為 0.120 mol，兩種反應物都剛好用完。
0.120 mol H₂ forms and both reactants are used up.
消耗 0.120 mol Mg 需要 0.240 mol HCl，比現有的多。
Consuming 0.120 mol Mg requires 0.240 mol HCl, more than is available.
H₂ 為 0.200 mol，餘下 Mg 0.100 mol。
0.200 mol H₂ forms and 0.100 mol Mg remains.
HCl:H₂ 是 2:1，不能直接以 HCl 的物質的量作氫氣產量。
The HCl:H₂ ratio is 2:1, so the HCl amount is not the H₂ yield.
takeaway: 先比較反應式所需比例，才判斷產量及剩餘物。
Compare required stoichiometric ratios before finding yield and leftovers.

title: 化學：電子轉移與氧化
Chemistry: electron transfer and oxidation
question: 反應中 Fe²⁺ 變成 Fe³⁺。哪項半反應及解釋正確？
Fe²⁺ changes to Fe³⁺ in a reaction. Which half-equation and explanation are correct?
options: Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + e⁻；失電子，被氧化。
Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + e⁻; it loses an electron and is oxidised.
電荷由 +2 增至 +3 對應失去一個負電荷。
Changing from +2 to +3 corresponds to losing one negative charge.
Fe²⁺ + e⁻ → Fe³⁺；得電子，被還原。
Fe²⁺ + e⁻ → Fe³⁺; it gains an electron and is reduced.
左邊總電荷 +1，右邊 +3，電荷不守恆。
The charge is +1 on the left and +3 on the right, so it is unbalanced.
Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + 3e⁻；失去三個電子。
Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + 3e⁻; it loses three electrons.
氧化數只增加 1，並非失去三個電子。
The oxidation number rises by one, not three.
takeaway: 半反應必須守恆原子及電荷；用電子得失判斷氧化還原。
Balance atoms and charge in half-equations; use electron transfer to identify redox.

title: 化學：量熱法與反應焓
Chemistry: calorimetry and enthalpy
question: 0.0500 mol 反應物反應，使 100 g 溶液升溫 7.0°C。比熱容量 4.2 J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹；忽略熱損失。每摩爾反應焓約為多少？
Reaction of 0.0500 mol warms 100 g of solution by 7.0°C. Specific heat capacity is 4.2 J g⁻¹ °C⁻¹; ignore heat loss. What is the approximate molar enthalpy change?
options: −58.8 kJ mol⁻¹
−58.8 kJ mol⁻¹
q=2940 J; the reaction releases heat, so ΔH=−2.940/0.0500=−58.8 kJ mol⁻¹.
+58.8 kJ mol⁻¹
+58.8 kJ mol⁻¹
數值大小正確，但升溫表示反應向溶液放熱，反應焓應為負。
The magnitude is right, but warming means the reaction releases heat, giving a negative enthalpy change.
−2.94 kJ mol⁻¹
−2.94 kJ mol⁻¹
2.94 kJ 是本次 0.0500 mol 的熱量，還須換算每摩爾。
2.94 kJ is the heat for 0.0500 mol; it must be converted to a per-mole value.
takeaway: 分清溶液吸收的熱量與反應焓符號，並換算每摩爾。
Distinguish solution heat gain from reaction enthalpy sign and convert to a molar quantity.

title: 化學：速率與總產量
Chemistry: rate versus total yield
question: 兩次反應的反應物用量、溫度相同。加催化劑後氣體體積曲線起初更陡，但最後平臺相同。最合理解釋是甚麼？
Two reactions use the same amounts and temperature. With a catalyst, the gas-volume curve is initially steeper but reaches the same final plateau. Which explanation fits best?
options: 催化劑增加反應速率，但沒有改變此反應的最終氣體產量。
The catalyst increases the rate but does not change this reaction's final gas yield.
斜率表示速率，平臺表示總氣量，兩者要分開解讀。
Slope represents rate; the plateau represents total gas volume.
催化劑增加反應物的物質的量，因此平臺相同。
The catalyst increases the amount of reactant, causing the same plateau.
用量相同且平臺相同，沒有反應物增多的證據。
The stated amounts and identical plateau do not support extra reactant.
曲線較陡證明平衡產量必定增加一倍。
The steeper curve proves the equilibrium yield has doubled.
起始斜率不能代替終點產量；相同平臺更直接否定加倍。
Initial slope is not final yield; the equal plateau contradicts a doubling.
takeaway: 曲線不同部分代表不同量；速率改善不等於總產量提高。
Different graph features represent different quantities; faster reaction does not mean greater total yield.

title: 化學：有機反應條件
Chemistry: conditions in organic reactions
question: 在課堂理論分析中，乙醇與過量酸化重鉻酸鉀在迴流條件下充分反應，主要有機產物是甚麼？
In a theoretical classroom analysis, ethanol reacts thoroughly with excess acidified potassium dichromate under reflux. What is the main organic product?
options: 乙酸。
Ethanoic acid.
過量氧化劑和迴流使第一級醇進一步氧化至羧酸。
Excess oxidant and reflux allow a primary alcohol to oxidise further to a carboxylic acid.
乙烯。
Ethene.
乙烯涉及脫水；題目提供的是氧化條件。
Ethene formation involves dehydration; the stated conditions are oxidising.
只會得到乙醛，不能繼續氧化。
Only ethanal, which cannot be oxidised further.
乙醛可進一步氧化；蒸餾收集與過量氧化劑迴流的條件不同。
Ethanal can oxidise further; distilling it off differs from refluxing with excess oxidant.
takeaway: 有機產物取決於試劑、用量和反應條件，不只取決於起始物。
Organic products depend on reagents, amounts and conditions as well as starting material.

title: 化學：平衡與工業取捨
Chemistry: equilibrium and industrial compromise
question: N₂(g)+3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g)，正反應放熱。降低溫度有利平衡產率，但工業不採極低溫，主要原因是甚麼？
N₂(g)+3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) is exothermic forward. Lower temperature favours equilibrium yield. Why is an extremely low temperature not used industrially?
options: 低溫使反應過慢，需在產率、速率及成本之間折衷。
A very low temperature makes the reaction too slow, requiring a compromise among yield, rate and cost.
平衡位置與達到平衡的速率是不同考慮。
Equilibrium position and the rate of reaching it are different considerations.
降低溫度會使放熱反應的平衡完全向左。
Lowering temperature shifts this exothermic equilibrium entirely to the left.
降溫有利放熱方向，不能用錯誤的平衡方向解釋工業選擇。
Lowering temperature favours the exothermic direction; this explanation reverses it.
催化劑能使任意低溫下的平衡產率必定達到 100%。
A catalyst guarantees 100% equilibrium yield at any low temperature.
催化劑改變速率，不改變同溫下的平衡常數。
A catalyst changes rates, not the equilibrium constant at a given temperature.
takeaway: 工業條件需要同時考慮熱力學、動力學與資源。
Industrial conditions balance thermodynamic, kinetic and resource considerations.

title: 化學：滴定數據與異常值
Chemistry: titration data and anomalous values
question: 25.00 cm³ NaOH 以 0.1000 mol dm⁻³ HCl 滴定，三次體積為 24.80、24.85、26.10 cm³；第三次註明越過終點。按前兩次相近讀數計，NaOH 濃度約多少？

25.00 cm³ NaOH is titrated with 0.1000 mol dm⁻³ HCl. Titres are 24.80, 24.85 and 26.10 cm³; the third is recorded as overshooting. Using the first two concordant readings, what is the NaOH concentration?
